issues: Console warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' hydration warning coming from JSX instrumentation inside <select><option> map; benign but produces a React DOM validation warning. Consider ensuring option children remain plain strings.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to ~1150 lines mixing storage, PDF, requisitions, assets, GRN, handovers; strongly recommend splitting into routers/modules (auth, org, requisitions, files, assets, grns, handovers) before Step 3.

download_file / requisition_pdf accept an 'auth' query-string token as a fallback authentication mechanism - putting JWTs in URLs risks leaking them to logs/referrers. Prefer a short-lived signed download token if needed, or rely on httpOnly cookies only.

put_object / get_object re-init storage on 404 which is good, but exceptions from _requests.raise_for_status() surface as unhandled 5xx to clients; wrap in try/except to return a clean 502 with a friendly detail.

SERVICE_STAGES appended to REQ_STATUSES/FINALIZED - status_for_step still relies on chain index rather than explicit tagging; consider tagging steps with their status key during build_approval_chain (already flagged in iter 1).

Handover POST allows any authenticated user to reassign assets by supplying an asset_id belonging to another user; consider server-side check that asset is currently in_stock before flipping status to 'assigned', and that the returning employee_name matches assigned_to for takeover.
GRN creates asset docs but skips silently when neither serial_no nor tag_id supplied; consider validating item quantity == len(assets) when tagging is expected, or returning a warning count.

PR number _pr_number is not idempotent across concurrent requests: two simultaneous GETs on the same requisition could both attempt increment before persistence - the counter increment is safe but the write-back guard 'if req.get(purchase_pr_no)' can race. Low risk but worth a $setOnInsert-style safeguard.
reportlab import at module scope adds ~200ms to first import; acceptable but pre-imports could be lazy if needed.
